description: This file defines a Vue component tree selector engine for both Vue 2 and Vue 3, enabling querying of Vue component instances and their DOM elements based on selectors.

classes.name: ComponentNode
classes.description: Represents a Vue component node with its name, children, root DOM elements, and props.

classes.name: VueVNode
classes.description: Type representing a Vue Virtual Node for Vue 2 and Vue 3, including properties for component type, parent, children, and DOM element references.

methods.name: basename
methods.description: Extracts the base filename without extension from a given filename string.

methods.name: toUpper
methods.description: Converts a character to uppercase, used as a replacer function in string transformations.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Converts a string to PascalCase based on delimiters.

methods.name: buildComponentsTreeVue3
methods.description: Builds a component tree for Vue 3 instances, extracting component names, children, and DOM roots.

methods.name: buildComponentsTreeVue2
methods.description: Builds a component tree for Vue 2 instances, extracting component names, children, and DOM roots.

methods.name: filterComponentsTree
methods.description: Filters a component tree based on a search function.

methods.name: findVueRoots
methods.description: Finds all Vue root instances within a DOM scope, supporting both Vue 2 and Vue 3.
